answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 8 graders each stake 30 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. A sonnet that can be verified, a island that can be measured, and a saffron that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
